rca_of_issue: 1) LifetimeCapCard crash — pure JS scoping. `styles` is created via useThemedStyles(makeStyles) inside DashboardInsights (line 345). LifetimeCapCard is a separate function component defined at file scope (line 238), so it captures nothing. Because the family-trial account uitest1782985661 has lifetime_cap data, DashboardInsights mounts <LifetimeCapCard/>, which explodes on the first `styles.insightCard` access. Cathy on Free plan short-circuits before that branch, so iteration_14 missed it. Fix: hoist styles into LifetimeCapCard. 2) Read-only mode PATCH leak — client-side interceptor missing/broken; frontend fires PATCH /api/auth/me straight to production for a subscription_status=expired user. Expected behavior per iteration_14 note was a client toast + no network hit. Root cause is in src/lib/api.ts or the AuthContext gate wrapping mutating requests; whichever guard used to short-circuit these calls has regressed or was never wired to /auth/me. 3) budget-calc contraction — copy string literal not updated across iteration_14→15.
